_note: Hand-written. Each pair is the same complaint in English and in Hinglish. Used to choose the embedding model (phase 6): a good model puts each Hinglish review nearest to its own English twin.

pairs.en: The payment fails every time and the money still gets deducted.
pairs.hinglish: payment har baar fail ho jata hai aur paisa bhi kat jata hai

pairs.en: The free version only lets me add three expenses a day now.
pairs.hinglish: free version mein ab din mein sirf teen expense add kar sakte hai

pairs.en: There are far too many ads, one before every single action.
pairs.hinglish: bahut zyada ads aate hai, har kaam se pehle ek ad dekhna padta hai

pairs.en: I cannot log in because the OTP never arrives.
pairs.hinglish: OTP aata hi nahi hai isliye login nahi ho raha

pairs.en: After the latest update the app crashes as soon as I open it.
pairs.hinglish: naye update ke baad app kholte hi band ho jata hai

pairs.en: Customer support never replies to my emails.
pairs.hinglish: customer care wale mere email ka koi jawab nahi dete

pairs.en: My refund has been pending for two weeks.
pairs.hinglish: mera refund do hafte se pending hai, abhi tak nahi aaya

pairs.en: The subscription is too expensive for students.
pairs.hinglish: subscription students ke liye bahut mehenga hai

pairs.en: The app is very slow and takes ages to load.
pairs.hinglish: app bahut slow hai, load hone mein bahut time lagta hai
notification ghanto baad aata hai, time pe nahi aata

pairs.en: The balances are calculated wrongly after someone edits an expense.
pairs.hinglish: expense edit karne ke baad balance galat dikhata hai

pairs.en: My account was blocked without any reason.
pairs.hinglish: mera account bina kisi wajah ke block kar diya

pairs.en: Exporting my data to a spreadsheet now needs a paid plan.
pairs.hinglish: data excel mein export karne ke liye ab paise dene padte hai

pairs.en: Very easy to use, splitting bills with friends takes seconds.
pairs.hinglish: use karna bahut easy hai, dosto ke saath bill split karna second ka kaam hai

pairs.en: This app drains my phone battery very quickly.
pairs.hinglish: ye app phone ki battery bahut jaldi khatam kar deta hai

pairs.en: Expenses I added offline disappeared after syncing.
pairs.hinglish: offline add kiye hue expense sync ke baad gayab ho gaye
